headlines.title: US High Relative Profitability (DUHP) Buys $69.9 Million More Broadcom on Nov. 12
headlines.summary: The fund added $444.6 million in net new positions, led by a $69.9 million purchase of Broadcom, while selling $9.3 million of Meta Platforms.

headlines.title: ETFs Are Buying Netflix (NFLX) on Nov. 12
headlines.summary: ETFs bought $59.6 million of Netflix stock, with 42 funds buying and 12 selling.

headlines.title: Trump Backs a Hollywood Tax Break So Movies “Must Stay in America.” Netflix and Disney Could Gain
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysPresident Trump backed a bipartisan bill that would give US film and TV productions a 20% federal tax credit on labor costs. A credit would lower what Netflix and Disney pay to film in the US, helping cash flow and margins.

headlines.title: Netflix, HBO, and Disney keep raising streaming prices
headlines.summary: Cord-cutting could become streaming-cutting as a new option gains viewers.

headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Following Ad Outlook Cuts Still Looks Undervalued To Some Investors
headlines.summary: Netflix (NFLX) cut its 2026 ad revenue and free cash flow outlook after delays in rolling out new ad features and partner integrations, putting the streaming group’s newer ad-supported model under closer investor scrutiny. Investors have reacted quickly to the ad guidance cut, with Netflix’s share price falling 11.9% over the past 30 days and down 31.7% year to date, while the 1 year total shareholder return is down 44.1%.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
